message.content: 页面5、6视觉良好。封面标题「澄图工单云产品介绍」出现单字换行（“绍”孤立一行），需修复。
message.reasoning_content:
rollout and boundary look good. Left vertical label on rollout overlaps left edge fine.

Now record visual assessment: cover has orphan char issue. Record visual with page_ids for all 6? I have evidence for all 6 pages visually (cover, problem, capability, pilot, rollout, boundary). Record visual assessment for all 6 with evidence ids, issues: cover title orphan.

Then revise cover.

Also content assessment: global_summary. But content may need revision first? Content is accurate. I could record content assessment now with global_summary=true and no issues, then fix cover visual and re-inspect cover visual + re-check content global? Content unaffected by visual fix. I'll record content after revise to reference current revision... Evidence ids reference revision 25abb0a3. After revising cover, revision changes; new content inspection needed? Rules: "修改后重查改动页并复核全稿内容". So better: revise cover first, then inspect content global + cover visual, then record assessments.

Order: record visual now? Rules require record_assessment per kind; issues must be recorded. I can record visual for pages 2-6 as pass and cover with issue. But if I revise, then re-record cover visual after. Simpler: revise cover first (visual fix based on evidence), then inspect cover visual + full content, then record.

Let me record visual assessment with the issue and then revise. Actually record_assessment records judgment; recording cover issue then revising then re-inspecting and re-recording would be cleaner evidence trail. But each tool call costs turns; fine.

Let me do: revise cover now.

Cover title "澄图工单云产品介绍" wrapping — instruct to reduce title font size or allow proper wrap so no orphan single char, e.g., break as "澄图工单云" / "产品介绍" two balanced lines, or fit one line.

Also cover date "待补充" — fine.

Revise cover.
